divisions.title: The Great Fish
divisions.summary: Jonah flees from the Lord's call, is swallowed by the great fish, and prays from the belly of Sheol

divisions.title: Nineveh
divisions.theme: Nineveh repents; Jonah wrestles with mercy
divisions.summary: Jonah preaches judgment, the city turns, and God reveals his heart for the nations

chapterSummaries.1: Jonah flees to Tarshish; a storm threatens the ship; Jonah thrown overboard
chapterSummaries.2: Jonah prays from the belly of the fish; the fish vomits him onto dry land
chapterSummaries.3: Jonah preaches to Nineveh; the city repents; God relents
chapterSummaries.4: Jonah is angry; God teaches him through a plant and a worm
